mu_name_from: MuMain loads MODEL_STAFF + i from Staff{i+1}; _enum.h names MODEL_LEGENDARY_STAFF = MODEL_STAFF + 5, and mu.db agrees: group 5 index 5, Item/Staff06.bmd.
why_this_one: Devias's merchants (Izabel, Zienna in src/sim/market.cpp) list the Legendary Staff, and the shelf dropped the line for want of a cooked mesh.

stats.note: The item's own row, copied from OpenMU's 0.75 initialiser rather than restated, with the call it came from beside it.
stats.from: openmu/src/Persistence/Initialization/Version075/Items/Weapons.cs. The 0.75 table, which is the version this server is being built to.

stance_from: MuWeapons.cs (the old client's table, LEGACY history 085a8169^:godot/Assets/Items/MuWeapons.cs): WeaponStance.Sword, TwoHanded: false - a one-handed staff, which the stance enum files under Sword. Width 1 in the call agrees.
sheet_from: Data/Item/a9.OZJ (32x64), a_2.OZJ (16x16) and shield11_a.OZJ, from MuMain at c0d74c4. The .bmd names a9.jpg on 276 triangles, a_2.jpg on 24 and shield11_a.jpg on 8; shield11_a.png was already in the tree from the Legendary Shield.
sheet_note: a9 is the staff: a deep blue orb in gold filigree and a blue-and-gold shaft, mean near (70, 80, 140). a_2 is a pale cyan gradient, which MU never draws on this model (HiddenMesh 1, below). shield11_a is a dark blue speckle that MU draws added and jittered, a shimmer inside the head.
glow_note: MU's ItemObjectAttribute (ZzzObject.cpp:5290): `case MODEL_LEGENDARY_STAFF: BlendMesh = 2; BlendMeshTexCoordU/V = (rand()%10)*0.1` - texture 2, shield11_a, drawn added with its UVs jumping each frame, no BlendMeshLight: the blue shimmer in the head. RenderPartObject draws the staff with HiddenMesh 1 (ZzzObject.cpp:9083), so a_2, the cyan gradient, is never shown; its islands are flagged hidden. MU also hangs a blue BITMAP_SHINY+1 sprite and a BITMAP_LIGHTNING+1 at (0, -145, 0) off the staff when held (ZzzCharacter.cpp:10284-10291); those are client effects, not in this recipe.
material_note: Eight islands on a9, sampled per triangle at their MU-UV centres: every one dark blue (means (15-24, 35-41, 80-94)) with thin gold filigree inside it - the head at the top (68), four wing-plates at the foot (40 each) and three shaft segments. Enamelled plate, as the Legendary set it belongs with, so plate_steel under the set's override: desaturation 1.0 keeps the blue and the gold, f0 0.42 at 0.70 of the art keeps the filigree, roughness 0.55. The gold cannot be split from the blue - it lies inside every island.

islands.note: a_2, the cyan gradient: MU draws the staff with HiddenMesh 1 (ZzzObject.cpp:9083), so it is never seen.

rig_note: No .rig.json, on purpose. Staff06.bmd has four bones (Sphere01, Sphere02, Mesh01, Box01) and one still key, so asset.sh reads it as a bind pose and borrows player.rig.json's motion - and joints are matched by name, where the player's skeleton has a Mesh01 of its own at the hand. The 40 a9 vertices bound to Mesh01 were skinned to it and flew off the staff: the gaps the user saw in game (2026-09-30). The .obj is MU's geometry already posed at action 0 key 0, which is all a rigid weapon needs, so the staff ships unskinned as the swords do.
